glosses: while, whilst, as (at the same time as)
as long as, so long as (expressing a condition)
however much, however many, “the..., the...” (constructing parallel comparatives)

examples.text: No me hables mientras estoy trabajando.
examples.en: Don't talk to me while I'm working.

examples.text: Esta carta llegó mientras estabas fuera.
examples.en: This letter arrived while you were out.

examples.text: Nada te pasará mientras estés conmigo.
examples.en: Nothing will happen to you as long as you're with me.
While there is life, there is hope.
